# Weave properties

<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p sindri-capabilities -- --write`. Do not edit by hand: a test fails when
this file disagrees with the property table in `sindri-weave`. -->

Every property a Weave stylesheet may declare for Sindri UI in this build of the engine,
read from the table the bridge applies declarations by. A property not listed here is
ignored.

The language itself (selectors, the cascade, `var()`, lengths, colors and responsive
rules) is described in [`docs/weave-reference.md`](../weave-reference.md). A length is
`px`, `vw`, `vh`, `%`, a plain number in overlay units, or `calc(…)`; a color is
`#rgb`, `#rgba`, `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `transparent`, `black` or `white`.

The machine-readable form of this page is
[`weave-reference.json`](weave-reference.json).

## Size and position

### `width`, `height`

The element's size. `auto` and `fit-content` size a layout to its children, padding and gaps, and a text element to its measured words.

- **Values:** a length, `auto` or `fit-content`
- **Writes:** the transform's scale; a text element's `sindri.ui.text` `bounds`
- **Example:** `width: 120px;`

### `min-width`, `max-width`, `min-height`, `max-height`

Limits on the size, which a layout also honors when it grows or shrinks the element. When the two conflict the minimum wins, as in CSS.

- **Values:** a length
- **Writes:** the transform's scale, and `sindri.ui.box` `min_size` or `max_size`
- **Example:** `min-width: 40px;`

### `x`, `y`

Where the element is, replacing the position the scene gave it.

- **Values:** a length
- **Writes:** the transform's position
- **Example:** `x: 10px;`

### `anchor`

Which point of the element its position names.

- **Values:** `center`, `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`, `top-left`, `top-right`, `bottom-left` or `bottom-right`
- **Writes:** `anchor` on `sindri.ui.image`, `sindri.ui.text` and `sindri.ui.shape`
- **Example:** `anchor: top-left;`

## Box

### `padding`, `padding-top`, `padding-right`, `padding-bottom`, `padding-left`

Room inside the element's edge: a layout's children start inside it. A percentage on any side is of the containing element's content width.

- **Values:** a length of zero or more; `padding` takes one to four, as in CSS
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.box` `padding`
- **Example:** `padding: 8px;`
- **Shorthand:** `padding` is expanded into its longhands where it is written, so a later longhand overrides one part of it.

### `margin`, `margin-top`, `margin-right`, `margin-bottom`, `margin-left`

Room a layout keeps free around the element. A percentage on any side is of the containing element's content width.

- **Values:** a length, negative allowed; `margin` takes one to four, as in CSS
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.box` `margin`
- **Example:** `margin: 8px;`
- **Shorthand:** `margin` is expanded into its longhands where it is written, so a later longhand overrides one part of it.

## Flex layout

### `display`

Makes the element a flex line or a grid that lays out its children.

- **Values:** `flex` or `grid`
- **Writes:** adds `sindri.ui.layout` (flex) or `sindri.ui.grid` (grid), removing the other
- **Example:** `display: grid;`

### `flex-direction`, `direction`

The axis a flex line runs along.

- **Values:** `row` or `column`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.layout` `direction`
- **Example:** `flex-direction: column;`

### `justify-content`

How a flex line spreads its children along its direction.

- **Values:** `start`, `center`, `end`, `space-between`, `space-around` or `space-evenly` (`flex-start`/`left` and `flex-end`/`right` mean `start` and `end`)
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.layout` `justify`
- **Example:** `justify-content: center;`

### `align-items`

Where children sit across a flex line, or across a grid's rows.

- **Values:** `start`, `center`, `end` or `stretch` (`flex-start` and `flex-end` too)
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.layout` `align`, and `sindri.ui.grid` `align_items`
- **Example:** `align-items: center;`

### `flex-wrap`

Whether children that do not fit start a new line.

- **Values:** `wrap` or `nowrap`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.layout` `wrap`
- **Example:** `flex-wrap: wrap;`

### `flex`

Shorthand for the three below, read as CSS reads it: `flex: 1` makes children share a line equally whatever their sizes.

- **Values:** `none`, `auto`, `initial`, or `<grow> [<shrink>] [<basis>]`
- **Writes:** `flex-grow`, `flex-shrink` and `flex-basis`, which it stands for
- **Example:** `flex: 1;`
- **Shorthand:** `flex` is expanded into its longhands where it is written, so a later longhand overrides one part of it.

### `flex-grow`, `flex-shrink`

The element's share of a line's spare room, or of its shortfall.

- **Values:** a number, zero or more
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.box` `grow` or `shrink`
- **Example:** `flex-grow: 2;`

### `flex-basis`

The element's size along the line before growing or shrinking.

- **Values:** a length of zero or more, `auto` or `content`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.box` `basis`
- **Example:** `flex-basis: 50%;`

### `order`

Where the element comes in its layout, lowest first.

- **Values:** a whole number
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.box` `order`
- **Example:** `order: 2;`

### `position`

`absolute` takes the element out of its parent's line or grid, which closes up as if it were not there; `x` and `y` then place it from the parent's middle, over or under its siblings.

- **Values:** `absolute`, or `static` (`relative` reads the same)
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.box` `absolute`
- **Example:** `position: absolute;`

### `align-self`

One child's own `align-items`.

- **Values:** `auto`, `start`, `center`, `end` or `stretch`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.box` `align_self`
- **Example:** `align-self: center;`

## Grid layout

### `grid-template-columns`, `grid-template-rows`

A grid's columns or rows.

- **Values:** tracks: `1fr`, `auto`, lengths and `repeat(n, …)`, or `none`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.grid` `columns` or `rows`
- **Example:** `grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;`

### `gap`, `row-gap`, `column-gap`

Space between a grid's tracks. A flex line takes the gap along it.

- **Values:** a length of zero or more; `gap` takes a row gap and a column gap
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.grid` `gap`, and `sindri.ui.layout` `spacing`
- **Example:** `gap: 8px;`

### `justify-items`

Where grid items sit across their cells.

- **Values:** `start`, `center`, `end` or `stretch`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.grid` `justify_items`
- **Example:** `justify-items: center;`

### `grid-column`, `grid-row`

Where an item starts in a grid, and how many tracks it spans.

- **Values:** `2`, `span 2`, `2 / 4`, `2 / span 3` or `auto`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.box` `grid_column` or `grid_row`
- **Example:** `grid-column: 2 / span 2;`

## Text

### `color`

The text's color.

- **Values:** a color
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.text` `color`
- **Example:** `color: #ff8800;`
- **Inherited:** an element without its own value takes its parent's.

### `font-size`, `line-height`, `letter-spacing`

The glyphs' size, the distance between baselines, and extra space after every glyph.

- **Values:** a length
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.text` `font_size`, `line_height` or `letter_spacing`
- **Example:** `font-size: 24px;`
- **Inherited:** an element without its own value takes its parent's.

### `font-weight`

The font's own bold face, or its regular one.

- **Values:** `normal`, `400`, `bold` or `700`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.text` `bold`
- **Example:** `font-weight: bold;`
- **Inherited:** an element without its own value takes its parent's.

### `font-style`

The font's own italic face, or its upright one.

- **Values:** `normal` or `italic`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.text` `italic`
- **Example:** `font-style: italic;`
- **Inherited:** an element without its own value takes its parent's.

### `text-align`

Where each line sits across the text's box.

- **Values:** `start` (or `left`), `center`, `end` (or `right`) or `justify`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.text` `line_align`
- **Example:** `text-align: center;`
- **Inherited:** an element without its own value takes its parent's.

### `text-wrap`

Whether lines break, and where: between words, or between any two glyphs.

- **Values:** `none` (or `nowrap`), `word` (or `wrap`) or `glyph`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.text` `wrap`
- **Example:** `text-wrap: word;`
- **Inherited:** an element without its own value takes its parent's.

### `text-transform`

The case the text is shown in, leaving the text itself as written.

- **Values:** `none`, `uppercase` or `lowercase`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.text` `case`
- **Example:** `text-transform: uppercase;`
- **Inherited:** an element without its own value takes its parent's.

## Shape

### `background`

The element's fill.

- **Values:** a color
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.shape` `fill`
- **Example:** `background: #1f2937;`

### `border-color`

The color of the element's outline.

- **Values:** a color
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.shape` `stroke`
- **Example:** `border-color: #ffffff;`

### `border-width`, `border-radius`

The outline's thickness, and how round the corners are.

- **Values:** a length in `px`, `vw` or `vh`, a percentage, or a plain number as a fraction of the element's shorter side
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.shape` `stroke_width` or `corner_radius`
- **Example:** `border-width: 4px;`

### `box-shadow`

A shadow behind the element's shape.

- **Values:** `<x> <y> [<blur> [<spread>]] [<color>]`, or `none`; one shadow, no `inset`
- **Writes:** `sindri.ui.shape` `shadow`
- **Example:** `box-shadow: 0 4px 8px #00000080;`

## Motion

### `transition`

Eases a property to a new value instead of jumping, for example on `:hover`. Colors, lengths and plain numbers ease; anything else changes at once.

- **Values:** comma-separated `<property> <duration> [<delay>] [<easing>]`; a property may be `all`, a duration is `ms` or `s`, and an easing is `linear`, `ease`, `ease-in`, `ease-out` or `ease-in-out`
- **Writes:** nothing itself: the properties it names ease to each new value
- **Example:** `transition: background 150ms ease-out;`
